 ORDER
The petitioner herein seeks a direction to 1st respondent to pass arbitration award in his claim petition dated 16.06.2023 within a stipulated time fixed by this Court.

2. According to the petitioner, he is the absolute owner of the land measuring 3030 sq.mtrs. in Survey No.366/2B, situated at Jakkasamuthiram Village, Palacode Taluk, Dharmapuri District.
3. A portion of above said land was acquired by the 2nd respondent for the purpose of laying Four-way Road - Hosur  Rayakottai  Dharmapuri  N.H.844.
Aggrieved by the quantum of compensation fixed by the 2nd respondent, the petitioner sought for enhancement of compensation and the matter was referred to arbitration by 1st respondent.
Though the claim petition of the petitioner seeking enhancement of compensation dated 16.06.2023 is pending on the file of the 1st respondent, till date, no order has been passed.
Therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 4.
Mr.A Selvendran, learned Special Government Pleader takes notice for the respondents 1 & 2 and Mrs.S.R.Sumathy, learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 3rd respondent.

sentences.text: 5. The learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents 1 & 2 would submit that the arbitral proceedings will be completed within the time fixed by this Court.

6. It is the duty of the 1st respondent to complete arbitral proceedings within the time limit prescribed under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and he cannot keep the arbitral proceedings pending for ever without passing final award.

Therefore, without going into the merits of the claim made by the petitioner, this Court is inclined to direct the 1st respondent to complete the arbitral proceedings pending on his file in respect of claim made by the petitioner and pass final award on its own merit, within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 7.
With the above direction, the Writ Petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
